{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH — include all statuses
filtered = data_clean[
    (data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (data_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Filtered group size (all statuses): {len(filtered)}')
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')"}
